request.description: `launch` builds and starts the story; `attach` connects to a game started with `kagari-desktop-runtime <dir> --debug-port <port>`.

manifestPath.description: Path to the project's `kagari.toml` (default: the nearest one from `cwd`).

target.description: The build target to debug, e.g. `v0` (default: the first of `build.targets`).

cwd.description: Working directory of the debug session (default: the worktree root).

enumDescriptions: Run the story in `kagari-desktop-runtime`, in a window.
Run the story in the query engine, without a window.
mode.description: How the story runs: in the desktop runtime's window, or headless in the query engine.

runtime.description: Window mode: path to `kagari-desktop-runtime` (default: next to `kagari`, else on PATH).

entry.description: Headless mode: the entry scene, e.g. `crate::Start` (default: the first).

buildFirst.description: Run `kagari build --profile debug` before starting. (Zed's own `build` key names a task to run first.)

stopOnEntry.description: Window mode: hold the story at its first step.

port.description: The port the game was started with (`--debug-port`).

host.description: The host the game listens on.
